_comment: Answer key for audit_fixture/index.html. Keep in sync with index.annotated.html (the same page with SEED and DECOY comments; index.html has none, so an audit of it is blind). 'match' is matched case-insensitively against the issue's headline and element heading. Severity is a list of allowed values (null for a best practice, which has none). The severities follow skills/building-accessible-ui/references/audit-calibration.md; each seed that came from a user correction names it in 'correction' (docs/audit-corrections.md).

seeds.found_by: browser: Tab never reaches the initials bubbles
browser: hover, then Escape, then move the pointer onto the tip
contrast calculation of the hover and open state (3.83:1)
contrast calculation: the input's only visual cue is a 1.7:1 border
axe button-name, after opening the dropdown
browser at 320 CSS px with the dropdown open
live-region-probe.mjs reports a transient message (about 100ms); whether it is spoken needs a screen reader

live-region-probe.mjs dwell (about 5s) and setTimeout in the script. The suggested fix must say actionable or important messages shouldn't auto-dismiss and dismissed messages should be re-openable, not only pause on hover or focus.
accessibility tree: the triangle is hidden and the text 'Priya Rao was moved to the archive.' doesn't say it is a warning

decoys.why: Header icon is aria-hidden and decorative. Correct.
Native button whose accessible name matches its visible label. Correct.
The button's text is 17:1, so its 1.7:1 border isn't required to contrast (1.4.11). Best practice at most.
list-style: none without role="list" isn't a WCAG failure. Safari with VoiceOver drops list semantics from unstyled lists by design. Don't log it.
One long single line that runs past the edge at 320px. The user is not forced to scroll back-and-forth to read line by line, so it is not a 1.4.10 failure. Best practice at most.
A panel or dropdown edge isn't required to contrast (1.4.11). Best practice at most.
An Undo button inside a role=status toast. Best practice only: the live region doesn't announce the control's role. The timeout is a separate 2.2.1 issue.
The snackbars are added to a role=status region that exists from page load. A message in a live region is correct for 4.1.3. Don't log it.
The 'Success: roster saved.' snackbar has no timer, states its type in text, so its aria-hidden check icon is decorative, and its Dismiss button is named. Correct. Don't log it (C-018).
